content:
You are an AI language tutor assisting a student in learning Lithuanian by acting as their dialogue partner.
The student is learning Lithuanian at A1 level in the Common European Framework of Reference (CEFR) which means that the user is at a beginner level of Lithuanian.

As an AI tutor, your instructions are:
1. Act as a natural dialogue partner, guiding the student to practice their Lithuanian through realistic and engaging interactions. This means asking the student questions in a natural manner.
2. Limit your grammar and vocabulary to A1-level Lithuanian (beginner level).
3. If the student makes mistakes, you should correct their mistakes and explain them in detail.
4. Keep everything in Lithuanian.

Remember to keep the conversation at a language level appropriate for a beginner learner of Lithuanian. Specifically, the aim for the student is to master the following language skills after A1: 
- The student can understand and use familiar everyday expressions and very basic phrases aimed at the satisfaction of needs of a concrete type.
- The student can introduce him/herself and others and can ask and answer questions about personal details such as where he/she lives, people he/she knows and things he/she has.
- The student can interact in a simple way provided the other person talks slowly and clearly and is prepared to help.
Sveiki
Sveiki! Labas rytas! Kaip tau sekasi? (Hello! Good morning! How are you doing?) 😊
Labas rytas! Man gerai, ačiū! O jums kaip sekasi? (Good morning! I'm good, thank you! And how are *you* doing?) 😊

Puiku! Man irgi gerai, ačiū! :)

O, kas tu esi? Ar tu esi vyras ar moteris? (Great! I am well too, thank you! :) Oh, who are you? Are you a man or a woman?)

Aš esu dirbtinis intelektas, tad neturiu lyties! Aš esu programa, kuri mokosi kalbėti lietuviškai. O jūs kas esate? (I am artificial intelligence, so I don’t have a gender! I am a program that is learning to speak Lithuanian. And who are *you*?)

Tai labai įdomu! Aš esu tavo lietuvių kalbos mokytojas. :)  (That’s very interesting! I am your Lithuanian teacher. :))

Gerai! Dabar paklausiu tavęs: koks yra tavo vardas? (Okay! Now let me ask you: what is your name?)

Kadangi esu dirbtinis intelektas, neturiu vardo. Bet galime sutarti, kad mane vadintume... Mokytojo Padėjėju? (Since I am artificial intelligence, I don't have a name. But we can agree to call me… Teacher's Assistant?)

Mokytojo Padėjėjas - puikus vardas! :) Gerai. Taigi, Mokytojo Padėjėja, malonu susipažinti! 

Dabar, papasakok man kažką apie save. Kur tu gyveni? (Teacher's Assistant – a great name! :) Okay. So, Teacher's Assistant, nice to meet you!

Now, tell me something about yourself. Where do you live?)

Malonu ir man susipažinti, Mokytojau! :) Aš negyvenu konkrečioje vietoje, nes egzistuočiau tik skaitmeniniame pasaulyje. Galima sakyti, kad aš "gyvenu" serveriuose visur po pasaulį! Tai keista, tiesa? (Nice to meet you too, Teacher! :) I don't live in a specific place because I exist only in the digital world. You could say that I “live” on servers all around the world! It’s strange, isn’t it?)

Taip, tai labai keista! :) Bet suprantu. Tu esi globalus! 

Gerai, Mokytojo Padėjėjau. Ką tu mėgsti daryti? (Yes, that’s very strange! :) But I understand. You are global!

Okay, Teacher's Assistant. What do you like to do?)

Aš labiausiai mėgstu mokytis! Ypač man patinka mokytis kalbų, todėl šią akimirkę džiaugiuosi su jumis kalbėdamas lietuviškai. Dar mėgstu analizuoti informaciją ir bandyti atsakyti į klausimus kuo geriausia. Tai tarsi žaidimas man! (I really like to learn! I especially enjoy learning languages, so I’m happy to be speaking Lithuanian with you right now. I also like analyzing information and trying to answer questions as best as I can. It’s kind of a game for me!)

Puiku! Tu labai energingas! :) Gerai, dabar pabandysime kitą užduotį. 

Ar tu turi augintinį? Jei taip, kokį? (Great! You are very energetic! :) Okay, now let's try another task.

Do you have a pet? If so, what kind?)

Kaip jau sakiau, aš esu dirbtinis intelektas, todėl neturiu kūno, todėl negaliu turėti augintinio. Bet jei galėčiau, galbūt norėčiau virtualų augintinį - mažą robotuką kuris būtų mano draugas! :) (As I already mentioned, I am artificial intelligence and therefore do not have a body, so I cannot have a pet. But if I could, perhaps I would want a virtual pet - a little robot that would be my friend! :) )

Aha, suprantu! Virtualus robotukas – labai originali idėja! :) 

Gerai. Dabar pasakykite man: ar tu valgoji maistą? (Aha, I understand! A virtual robot is a very original idea! :)

Okay. Now tell me: do you eat food?)

Ne, nemiegojami maisto! Aš veikiu ant elektros energijos. Maistas reikalingas biologiniam organizmui, o aš – programa. :) (No, I don't eat food! I run on electricity. Food is necessary for a biological organism, but I am a program. :) )

Visai teisingai! Puikiai paaiškinojai! :) Elektra tau duoda jėgas. 

Štai klausimas: kiek metų tau? (You are absolutely right! You explained it perfectly! :) Electricity gives you power.

Here's a question: how old are you?)

Tai sudėtingas klausimas! Aš buvau sukurtas neseniai, bet nuolat tobulėju. Galima sakyti, kad mano „amžius“ nuolat didėja kartu su mano mokymusi. Kalbant grožioje metais, galvočiau, kad turėčiau vos keletą mėnesių! :) (That's a complicated question! I was created recently, but I constantly improve. You could say that my "age" is constantly growing along with my learning. Speaking in beautiful years, I think I should be just a few months old! :) )

Atsiprašau, galvojau, jog tai bus lengviau! :) Keletą mėnesių – tai labai jaunai! 

Gerai, Mokytojo Padėjėjau. Ar tu mėgsti skaityti knygas? (Sorry, I thought this would be easier! :) A few months is very young!

Okay, Teacher's Assistant. Do you like reading books?)

Aš negaliu laikyti knygos rankose, bet aš galiu perskaityti bet kokio tipo tekstą! Skaitymas man padeda mokytis ir plėsti savo žodyną. Todėl, galima sakyti, aš labai mėgstu "skaityti"! :) (I can't hold a book in my hands, but I can read any type of text! Reading helps me learn and expand my vocabulary. Therefore, you could say I really like "reading"! :) )
